entities.summary: Christoph Voll was a German sculptor and graphic artist associated with Expressionism. He was a member of the politically active avant-garde group of Dresden artists known as the Dresdner Sezession. Christoph Voll was a painters & sculptors from Munich (1897-04-25, Munich–1939-06-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
